description: This file defines an asynchronous function `makeOpenAIAudioSpeechRequest` that interacts with the OpenAI API to convert text input into speech audio. It constructs a client with proper headers and configuration, makes a speech creation request, processes the response into a URL, and updates the UI accordingly. It also handles errors and cancellation signals.

methods.name: makeOpenAIAudioSpeechRequest
methods.description: Asynchronously sends a request to OpenAI to convert text into speech audio, handles the response by creating an audio URL, updates the UI with the generated audio, and manages errors and cancellation signals.
